item.title: SynDexy Delivers First Small Batch of C1 Dexterous Humanoids for Precision Electronics Assembly
item.description: Beijing startup SynDexy has delivered its first small batch of C1 humanoids for precision assembly at electronics plants, six months after development began. Key tasks exceeded 98% success in tests.

item.title: Midea's Six-Arm MIRO U Robot Fastened Back-Panel Screws on 100,000 Washing Machines in Three Months
item.description: Midea's six-arm MIRO U has driven back-panel screws on 100,000 washers over three months, six screws in about 10 seconds, as Guangdong reports more than 2,000 humanoid robots in factories.

item.title: Tencent Opens Its Internal Data Tool Beacon AI to the Public for Plain-Language Data Analysis
item.description: Tencent has opened Beacon AI, its data analysis platform used by over 100 internal teams, to outside users. It builds dashboards from plain language and adds Self-Harness, skills and MCP access.

item.title: Zhuoyu Brings Its Driving Model to Heavy Trucks, PDS 4 Highway Assist Now in Mass Production
item.description: Zhuoyu Technology moved its passenger-car driving model to heavy trucks. PDS 4 highway assist is in mass production, with a 500-meter in-cabin lidar and fuel-saving logic trimming use 4.5% to 7.5%.
